title: 9 Signs a Godly Man Has Learned to Rule Himself
caption:
9 signs a godly man has learned to rule himself. Not the version everyone praises for having it together.

He can walk away from the show without watching the ending. He waits to send the text until he's not angry anymore. He can sit in a quiet house without reaching for noise. He finishes the set when no one's counting his reps, and he skips the second plate because he decided to, not because he ran out.

He can be alone with his phone and put it down anyway. He tells the truth even when the lie would sell easier. He goes to bed on time the night he doesn't want to. And he can lose and still shake the man's hand.

A city with no walls gets overrun. A man with no self-control is the same city.

#faith #selfcontrol #godlymen #christianman #discipline #discipleship #manofgod
theme: He runs his life — his impulses don't control him.
